authorized_scope: R4-0 train-only convergence pilot followed by the R4-A action-relevant oracle utility gate. R4-B, a new test, M4, M5, B-core and formal policy training remain unauthorized unless the preceding gate explicitly passes.
revision_reason: R3 showed that a converged old B representation degraded the 16-step action metric. R4 changes both the information bottleneck and the fusion mechanism while preserving a hard HC fallback and matched capacity controls. The first train-only R4-0 pilot under gate SHA256 7a95bec8d1ed47c8210f408487c6ef1afb8b72e561e5ab0fce24c81bbcbad9c8 reached the 360-epoch cap before tune access. Its successor gate SHA256 3dbfeacc34389c547baa8693a8e36ae480aee36af52b1549997d33197f569445 completed the train-only pilot and froze 520 formal epochs, but the first oracle_arb and noise_residual formal seeds both reached that cap while still improving (best epochs 514 and 516); test_paths_opened=0. Per the preregistered CAP_REACHED rule, their R4-A results remain inconclusive and are preserved under the old run root. This budget-only revision keeps architecture, data, seeds, learning rates, metrics, controls and acceptance thresholds unchanged, reruns the train-only pilot, and increases only the formal post-pilot safety margin before any R4-A result from this revision exists.

prerequisites.note: The R3 HC checkpoint is audit context only. It hit the 200-epoch cap before exhausting patience, so R4 trains and freezes a new converged HC before any oracle comparison.

data.rule: R4-A failure terminates R4 without generating, collecting, opening or reusing any test episode.

arb_schema.representation: six typed relation/event tokens with eight binary fields each; no frame index, episode id, fixed robot id, stage/progress, remaining goals, teammate future action, P or T input

field_to_action_semantics.contact_grasp_custody: continue, release, wait or take over
field_to_action_semantics.handoff_event: release after confirmed transfer or hold when transfer is incomplete
field_to_action_semantics.teammate_motion_state: synchronize, yield or cover a missing role
field_to_action_semantics.blocking_collision: pause, avoid contention or change grasp timing
field_to_action_semantics.visibility_staleness: use a current relation or suppress an obsolete residual
field_to_action_semantics.uncertainty_missingness: fall back exactly to HC when the side path is not trustworthy

architecture.hc: R3-size LayerNorm-MLP trained on legal current observation plus 16-step history; selected by the six-task macro episode NRMSE over the first 16 future steps and then frozen
architecture.arb_side_path: four 64-dimensional action queries attend to six typed ARB tokens through four-head cross-attention
architecture.residual: zero-initialized final residual heads modify only the first 16 future action steps
architecture.fallback: final_action = frozen_HC + reliability * sigmoid(gate) * delta_action; reliability=0 must be elementwise identical to frozen HC
architecture.legacy_control: the old 192-width social interface with only the frozen R3 B slice active enters a direct residual MLP; P and T remain zero

seeds.selection_rule: all three residual seeds are reported; no best-seed selection

r4_0_pilot.split: train episodes only, with an episode-disjoint deterministic six-episode-per-task holdout
r4_0_pilot.rule: Freeze the formal max epoch and patience from the HC and oracle-residual train-only curves. If either pilot branch reaches the cap before exhausting patience, report INCONCLUSIVE_TRAINING/CAP_REACHED and do not read tune.

training.hc_training_loss: masked MSE over up to 100 future steps, as in R3
training.residual_training_loss: masked MSE over exactly the first 16 future steps
training.checkpoint_selection_metric: six-task macro episode NRMSE over exactly the first 16 future steps
training.formal_convergence_rule: every formal HC and residual branch must exhaust frozen patience; hitting max epoch while still improving is INCONCLUSIVE_TRAINING/CAP_REACHED

r4_a_acceptance.seed_direction_rule: at least two of three oracle seeds have positive macro gain and no seed has a 95% CI entirely at or below -3%
r4_a_acceptance.aggregation: per-episode median error over three frozen seeds, followed by 10000 task-stratified paired episode bootstrap resamples
r4_a_acceptance.control_rule: oracle ARB must have a positive 95% CI lower bound versus zero residual, input-independent noise residual and legacy concat
r4_a_acceptance.failure_rule: if any oracle check fails, stop R4 without training an ARB predictor or opening a test split

later_stages_frozen_but_unauthorized.r4_b: Only PASSED_M3_R4_A_ORACLE_UTILITY may authorize implementation and execution of the predictor/calibration/shortcut gate already described in the roadmap.
later_stages_frozen_but_unauthorized.r4_c: Only an R4-B pass may authorize one newly generated and sealed test; R2 test episodes must never be reused.
later_stages_frozen_but_unauthorized.b_core: R4 never directly unlocks B-core; M4 and M5 must also pass.
